# Scenario 07 is a token of a `keep` kind and the word `revoked` (ADR-0110 addenda (10)–(16); P/08.2 N1.6a `jti`, `door`; P/08.7 N1.3 `body`; roadmap 4.5). The kind `vault` of the manifest `testsub2` is `keep: true`. Steps 3–6 — `jti` is constant for the target. Steps 7–8 — a word not equal to the `jti` of the row is an ordinary request, `jti` is the earlier one. Steps 9–11 — a word equal to the `jti` of the row: so asks a member whose receiver refused the token with `revoked` while the holder does not know of the revocation (a copy older than `DELETE`); the holder puts `jti` into `domain/revoked` in one batch with the new row, issues a new `jti`, the earlier token is refused at the member by the revocation. Step 12 — a word at a kind without `keep` — 400. Steps 13–15 — `DELETE` revokes the tokens of the target, a repeated one — 404. The copy older than `DELETE` itself (the transfer from a copy), the raise of `exp` at a restore, the limit `REVOKED_WORDS` and a full row `domain/revoked` (409) — by reading: the stand does not hold a copy before `DELETE` longer than `BACKUP_EVERY` and does not fill the revocations row.
